common.footer: {{appName}}, Kigali. All times are Kigali time (UTC+2).
common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
common.nonRefundable: The booking fee is non-refundable if you cancel.

bookingConfirmation.subject: Booking confirmed: {{service}} on {{date}} ({{reference}})
bookingConfirmation.preheader: Your date is secured. Your booking reference is {{reference}}.
bookingConfirmation.heading: Your booking is confirmed
bookingConfirmation.intro: Thank you for your booking. We have received your booking fee and your date is secured.
bookingConfirmation.outstanding: The remaining {{amount}} is due after the shoot. We will send you a link to pay it.
bookingConfirmation.paidInFull: Your booking is paid in full.
bookingConfirmation.linkNote: Keep this email. The link above is how you view or cancel your booking. Anyone with the link can open it, so please do not share it.

adminNewBooking.subject: New booking: {{client}}, {{service}} on {{date}}
adminNewBooking.heading: New booking
adminNewBooking.intro: {{client}} has booked and paid the booking fee. The booking is confirmed.
adminNewBooking.openCalendar: Open the day in your calendar

sessionFeeRequest.subject: Session fee due for your booking {{reference}}
sessionFeeRequest.preheader: The remaining {{amount}} for your shoot is now due.
sessionFeeRequest.heading: Your session fee is due
sessionFeeRequest.intro: Thank you for your shoot on {{date}}. The remaining session fee is now due.
sessionFeeRequest.afterPaying: We will email you a receipt once your payment has arrived.

paymentReceipt.subject: Payment received: {{amount}} for {{reference}}
paymentReceipt.heading: Thank you, your payment has arrived
paymentReceipt.intro: This email is your receipt for the {{kind}} of {{amount}}.
paymentReceipt.paidInFull: Your booking is now paid in full.
paymentReceipt.sameLink: Your booking link has not changed: the one in your confirmation email still opens this booking.
paymentReceipt.overpaid: This is {{amount}} more than your booking comes to. We will refund the difference to you.

photoDelivery.subject: Your photos are ready ({{reference}})
photoDelivery.heading: Your photos are ready
photoDelivery.intro: Your photos from your {{service}} shoot are ready to download.
photoDelivery.expiry: The download link works until the end of {{date}} (Kigali time). Please save your photos before then: after that date the link will no longer work.

cancellation.subject: Booking cancelled: {{reference}}
cancellation.preheader: Your booking for {{date}} has been cancelled.
cancellation.heading: Your booking has been cancelled
cancellation.byClient: As you asked, we have cancelled your booking for {{service}} on {{date}}.
cancellation.byAdmin: We are sorry: we have had to cancel your booking for {{service}} on {{date}}.
cancellation.feeKept: As stated when you booked, the booking fee of {{amount}} is non-refundable.
cancellation.refundDue: We owe you a refund of {{amount}}. We will contact you to arrange it.
cancellation.rebook: You are welcome to book again at any time.

reschedule.subject: Your booking {{reference}} has moved to {{date}}
reschedule.heading: Your booking has a new time
reschedule.intro: Your booking for {{service}} has been moved. Everything else about it stays the same.
reschedule.sameLink: Your booking link has not changed: the one in your confirmation email still opens this booking.

accessLinkResend.subject: Your booking link ({{reference}})
accessLinkResend.preheader: A new link to your booking.
accessLinkResend.heading: Here is your booking link
accessLinkResend.intro: Here is a new link to your booking for {{service}} on {{date}}.
accessLinkResend.oldLinks: Any link we sent you before no longer works. Keep this email, and please do not share the link.

clientNote.subject: A message about your booking ({{reference}})
clientNote.heading: A message from your photographer
clientNote.alsoOnPage: You will also find this message on your booking page.

emailChangeConfirm.subject: Confirm your new email ({{reference}})
emailChangeConfirm.preheader: One click to use this address for your booking.
emailChangeConfirm.heading: Confirm your new email
emailChangeConfirm.intro: You asked to use {{email}} for your booking. Confirm it, and we will write to this address from now on.
emailChangeConfirm.expiry: This link works for 24 hours. Until you confirm, we keep writing to the address we had.
emailChangeConfirm.notYou: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: nothing changes unless the button is used.

emailChangedNotice.subject: Your booking email was changed ({{reference}})
emailChangedNotice.preheader: We will now write to a different address.
emailChangedNotice.heading: Your booking email was changed
emailChangedNotice.intro: The email for your booking is now {{email}}. This is the last message about it we will send to this address.
emailChangedNotice.notYou: If you did not make this change, reply to this email straight away so the photographer can put it back.

bookingLinks.subject: Your booking links
bookingLinks.heading: Here are your booking links
bookingLinks.intro: You asked for the links to your bookings. Each button below opens one of them.
bookingLinks.oldLinks: Any link we sent you before no longer works. Keep this email, and please do not share the links.
bookingLinks.notYou: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email: your bookings have not changed, only their links.

paymentReceived.subject: Payment received: {{amount}} from {{client}} ({{reference}})
paymentReceived.heading: Payment received
paymentReceived.openCalendar: Open the day in your calendar

retriesExhausted.subject: A message could not be sent
retriesExhausted.preheader_one: The system gave up after {{count}} attempt.
retriesExhausted.preheader_other: The system gave up after {{count}} attempts.
retriesExhausted.heading: A message could not be sent
retriesExhausted.intro_one: After {{count}} attempt, the system gave up sending the message below. It will not try again.
retriesExhausted.intro_other: After {{count}} attempts, the system gave up sending the message below. It will not try again.
retriesExhausted.advice: If it was for a client, you may want to contact them directly.

messages.session_fee_request: Session fee request to the client
messages.access_link_resend: New booking link to the client
messages.booking_links: Booking links the client asked for
messages.email_change_confirm: Confirmation link to a new client email
messages.email_changed_notice: Notice to an old client email
messages.gcal_create: Adding the booking to your Google Calendar
messages.gcal_update: Updating the booking in your Google Calendar
messages.gcal_delete: Removing the booking from your Google Calendar

loginLockout.subject: Admin sign-in locked after {{count}} failed attempts
loginLockout.heading: Admin sign-in is locked
loginLockout.intro: The wrong password was entered for the admin account {{count}} times, so sign-in is locked until {{until}} (Kigali time).
loginLockout.ifNotYou: If this was not you, someone may be trying to guess your password. Once the lock ends, consider resetting your password.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your admin password
passwordReset.preheader: The link works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time).
passwordReset.heading: Reset your admin password
passwordReset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for the admin account. The link below works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time).
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

refundDue.subject: Refund due: {{amount}} to {{client}} ({{reference}})
refundDue.preheader: The system does not move money: this refund is yours to make.
refundDue.heading: A refund is due

reasons.admin_cancelled: You cancelled this booking, so the client is owed a full refund.
reasons.late_payment_slot_taken: The client's payment arrived after their hold had expired and the time had been booked by someone else.
reasons.duplicate_payment: The client paid the booking fee twice. The booking stands on the first payment; this one is owed back.
reasons.duplicate_session_fee: This payment arrived after the booking had already been paid in full, so all of it is owed back.
reasons.session_fee_after_client_cancel: The client cancelled after paying the session fee, which is refunded.
reasons.overpayment: This booking has been paid more than it is worth, so the difference is owed back.
reasons.booking_fee_after_client_cancel: The client cancelled, and your cancellation policy refunds the booking fee.

refundDue.howTo: The system does not move money. Refund the client through {{provider}}, then record the refund on the booking.
refundDue.howToCash: The system does not move money. This was paid in cash: give it back to the client, then record the refund on the booking.
refundDue.preheaderPlatform: The client paid online, so the platform refunds them.
refundDue.howToPlatform: The client paid online, into the platform's account, so the platform refunds them and records it: there is nothing for you to send. If this payment's earning was already paid out to you, it comes off your next payout.
refundDue.howToPlatformOverpayment: The client paid online, into the platform's account, so the platform will return the difference to the client and record it: there is nothing for you to do. Your earnings count only what was due.

bookingCancelled.subject: Booking cancelled: {{client}}, {{date}} ({{reference}})
bookingCancelled.heading: A client cancelled their booking
bookingCancelled.intro: {{client}} cancelled their booking for {{service}} on {{when}}. The time is free again.
bookingCancelled.feeKept: Their booking fee of {{amount}} is non-refundable and has been kept.
bookingCancelled.feeRefunded: Your cancellation policy refunds their booking fee of {{amount}}. A separate alert tells you how to send it.

retriesExhausted.subject: A message could not be sent
retriesExhausted.preheader_one: The system gave up after {{count}} attempt.
retriesExhausted.preheader_other: The system gave up after {{count}} attempts.
retriesExhausted.heading: A message could not be sent
retriesExhausted.intro_one: After {{count}} attempt, the system gave up sending the message below. It will not try again.
retriesExhausted.intro_other: After {{count}} attempts, the system gave up sending the message below. It will not try again.
retriesExhausted.advice: It concerns no photographer, so it has come to the platform admins. If it was for someone, you may want to contact them directly.

accountPasswordReset.subject: Reset your password
accountPasswordReset.preheader: The link works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time).
accountPasswordReset.heading: Reset your password
accountPasswordReset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for your account. The link below works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time).
accountPasswordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.

loginLockout.subject: Sign-in locked after {{count}} failed attempts
loginLockout.heading: Sign-in to your account is locked
loginLockout.intro: The wrong password was entered for your account {{count}} times, so sign-in is locked until {{until}} (Kigali time).
loginLockout.ifNotYou: If this was not you, someone may be trying to guess your password. Once the lock ends, consider resetting your password.

accountExists.subject: You already have an account
accountExists.preheader: Someone tried to sign up again with this address. Nothing was changed.
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.intro: Someone, probably you, tried to create a new account with this email address. There is already an account for it, so nothing was created and nothing was changed.
accountExists.forgot: Sign in with your existing password. If you have forgotten it, use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page to choose a new one.
accountExists.ifNotYou: If this was not you, you can ignore this email: your account and your password stay as they are.

changed.subject: Your payout method was changed
changed.heading: Your payout method was changed
changed.intro: On {{when}} (Kigali time), your payouts were redirected to your {{destination}}.

added.subject: A payout method was added to your studio
added.heading: A payout method was added
added.intro: On {{when}} (Kigali time), your {{destination}} was saved as where your payouts go.

payoutMethodChanged.ifNotYou: If this was not you, someone else knows your password. Reset it now, then contact the platform so that no payout is sent to this destination.

changed.subject: Your password was changed
changed.heading: Your password was changed
changed.intro: On {{when}} (Kigali time), the password of your account was changed.

added.subject: A password was added to your account
added.heading: A password was added to your account
added.intro: On {{when}} (Kigali time), a password was added to your account. You can now sign in with your email address and this password, as well as with Google.

passwordChanged.preheader: Every other device signed in to your account has been signed out.
passwordChanged.signedOut: Every other device signed in to your account has been signed out.
passwordChanged.ifNotYou: If this was not you, someone else can sign in to your account. Use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page now to choose a new password.

emailChanged.subject: Your account email was changed
emailChanged.preheader: Your account now uses a different email address.
emailChanged.heading: Your account email was changed
emailChanged.intro: On {{when}} (Kigali time), the email address of your account was changed to {{email}}. This is the last message about your account we will send to this address.
emailChanged.bookings: Bookings already made under this address stay in your account.
emailChanged.ifNotYou: If you did not make this change, someone else knows your password. Reply to this email straight away so we can help you get your account back.

accountDeleted.subject: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.preheader: Your account and its sign-in details are erased.
accountDeleted.heading: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.intro: On {{when}} (Kigali time), your account was deleted at your request. Your name, phone number and sign-in details are erased, and you can no longer sign in. This is the last message about your account we will send.
accountDeleted.bookings: Bookings you made stay with the photographers who took them, who must keep their records. An upcoming booking goes ahead: open it with the link in its confirmation email.
accountDeleted.ifNotYou: If you did not ask for this, reply to this email straight away.

accountVerifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
accountVerifyEmail.preheader: The link works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time).
accountVerifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
accountVerifyEmail.intro: Confirm this address to finish setting up your account. The link below works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time), and asks for the password you chose when you signed up.
accountVerifyEmail.notYourPassword: If the page asks for a password you never chose, someone else signed up with your address. Use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page instead: choosing a new password confirms your address and makes the account yours.
accountVerifyEmail.ignore: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.preheader: The link works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time).
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.intro: You asked to use this address for your account. Confirm it below: the link works once, until {{until}} (Kigali time), and asks for your account password.
emailChange.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email: nothing changes until the link is used.

photographerApplicationReceived.subject: New photographer application
photographerApplicationReceived.preheader: A new studio is waiting for review.
photographerApplicationReceived.heading: A photographer has applied
photographerApplicationReceived.intro: {{displayName}} has signed up as a photographer. Their studio is pending until a platform admin approves it.
photographerApplicationReceived.submittedSubject: A studio is ready for review
photographerApplicationReceived.submittedPreheader: A photographer has finished setting up and asks to be approved.
photographerApplicationReceived.submittedHeading: A studio is ready for review
photographerApplicationReceived.submittedIntro: {{displayName}} has finished the setup checklist and submitted their studio for review. It stays pending, not listed and not bookable, until a platform admin approves it.
photographerApplicationReceived.handleChangedSubject: A studio under review changed its handle
photographerApplicationReceived.handleChangedPreheader: Its public address is no longer the one it submitted.
photographerApplicationReceived.handleChangedHeading: A studio under review changed its handle
photographerApplicationReceived.handleChangedIntro: {{displayName}} changed their handle after submitting their studio for review. The handle becomes their public address, fixed for good once the studio is approved, so check the new one before you approve.

photographerApproved.subject: Your studio is approved
photographerApproved.preheader: Clients can now find you and book you.
photographerApproved.heading: Your studio is approved
photographerApproved.intro: Good news: your studio has been approved. Your profile is now listed in the directory, and clients can book your services.
photographerApproved.trial: Your free trial has started: until {{date}}, clients can book you at no cost to you. Before it ends, choose a monthly or yearly plan in your studio to keep taking bookings.

photographerSuspended.subject: Your studio has been suspended
photographerSuspended.preheader: Your profile is hidden and new bookings are paused.
photographerSuspended.heading: Your studio has been suspended
photographerSuspended.intro: A platform admin has suspended your studio. Your profile is hidden from the directory, and clients cannot make new bookings with you.
photographerSuspended.existingBookings: Bookings you already have are not affected: they carry on as planned, and you can still sign in to manage them.
photographerSuspended.questions: If you have questions, or think this is a mistake, reply to this email.

payoutSent.subject: Payout sent: {{amount}}
payoutSent.heading: Your payout has been sent
payoutSent.intro: We have sent you {{amount}}, to your {{destination}}.
payoutSent.feeNote: No commission is taken. The transfer fee is deducted by the provider, so the amount that arrives may be slightly less.

subscriptionReminder.trialEndingSubject_one: Your free trial ends in {{count}} day
subscriptionReminder.trialEndingSubject_other: Your free trial ends in {{count}} days
subscriptionReminder.endingPreheader: Renew before {{date}} to keep taking bookings.
subscriptionReminder.trialEndingHeading: Your free trial is ending soon
subscriptionReminder.endingIntro: Your current period ends on {{date}}. Pay for a month or a year before then, and clients can keep booking you without a break.
subscriptionReminder.earlyNote: Paying early loses nothing: the time you pay for starts when your current period ends.
subscriptionReminder.pastDueSubject: Your subscription has ended: renew to take bookings again
subscriptionReminder.pastDueIntro: Your subscription period ended on {{endedOn}}, so clients cannot make new bookings with you. Your profile stays in the directory, marked as not taking bookings, until {{graceEndsOn}}. After that it is hidden.
subscriptionReminder.existingBookings: Bookings you already have are not affected: they carry on as planned, and clients can still pay what they owe.

subscriptionReceipt.subject: Subscription receipt: {{amount}}
subscriptionReceipt.heading: Thank you for your payment
subscriptionReceipt.intro: We received your payment of {{amount}} for the {{plan}} plan. Your studio is covered until {{date}}.
subscriptionReceipt.stackNote: Each payment adds its time after the time you have already paid for, so nothing is lost by paying early.

subscriptionExpired.subject: Your profile is no longer listed
subscriptionExpired.preheader: Renew your subscription to be listed again.
subscriptionExpired.heading: Your subscription has expired
subscriptionExpired.intro: Your subscription period ended on {{endedOn}} and the grace period is over. Your profile is no longer listed in the directory, and clients cannot make new bookings with you.
subscriptionExpired.existingBookings: Bookings you already have are not affected: they carry on as planned, and clients can still pay what they owe.
subscriptionExpired.renewNote: You can renew at any time from your studio. Your profile is listed again as soon as the payment goes through.
